tools.name: billey_list_clients
tools.description: List the clients of the book (name, contact, payment terms, collection method). Returns cursor pagination: follow links.next. Use updated_after to sync only changes. billey API: GET /api/v1/clients.

tools.name: billey_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by id, with its contact and payment details. billey API: GET /api/v1/clients/{client}.

tools.name: billey_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with status, dates, totals (decimal strings), the client summary and line items. Filter with updated_after for changes since a time. Returns cursor pagination. billey API: GET /api/v1/invoices.

tools.name: billey_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, with its client summary and line items. billey API: GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice}.

tools.name: billey_list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes (offers) with status, dates, totals and line items. Returns cursor pagination. billey API: GET /api/v1/quotes (needs the quotes:read ability).

tools.name: billey_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses (purchase costs) with amounts, dates, the vendor summary and the account. Returns cursor pagination. billey API: GET /api/v1/expenses.

tools.name: billey_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors (suppliers) with their contact and payment details. Returns cursor pagination. billey API: GET /api/v1/vendors.

tools.name: billey_list_bank_transactions
tools.description: List imported bank transactions (amount, executed date, counterparty, match and allocation state). Returns cursor pagination. billey API: GET /api/v1/bank-transactions (needs transactions:read).

tools.name: billey_list_products
tools.description: List products and services from the book's catalogue (unit price, VAT percentage, SKU). Returns cursor pagination. billey API: GET /api/v1/products (needs products:read).

tools.name: billey_list_projects
tools.description: List projects with their client summary. Returns cursor pagination. billey API: GET /api/v1/projects (needs projects:read).

tools.name: billey_list_time_entries
tools.description: List logged time entries (hours and hourly rate as decimal strings, date, project). Returns cursor pagination. billey API: GET /api/v1/time-entries (needs time-entries:read).
